messages:
sara: heads up — I pushed a tiny change that lets ops adjust feature-flag TTLs in realtime from the console. goal was to reduce noisy rollbacks, but i want to make sure we have the right safety/telemetry before we keep this live

miguel: link to the change?

sara: https://console/redwood/flags/ttl-edit (sandbox only). implementation is small: we accept `ttl_seconds` on the PATCH and apply zero-downtime snapshot.

miguel: main worry is silent drift — if someone ups TTL we might keep cached prefixes longer and hide regressions. need immediate telemetry signals

tarun: agree. can we emit an event `flag.ttl.updated` with old/new + actor + trace_id? that lets us correlate perf/qa alerts.

emily-dx: also UX: show a compact diff preview and require a checkbox for "Apply to active snapshots" vs "Apply to new snapshots only". defaults to the safer option.

sara: good call. current flow always applies to active snapshots which is why i'm nervous. i can make the UI choose the safer option by default.

jess-runbooks: ops playbook question — if someone increases TTL and we see a cache hit-rate jump, what's the rollback path? can we auto-scan and suggest a reverse action?

miguel: we already have a bot that creates revert suggestions for traffic-shift flags. can we reuse that?

deploy-bot: created issue #6123 — "revert-suggestion: TTL-based cache regressions" with checklist template. (automated) :white_check_mark:

tarun: telemetry: add a derived metric `cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_flag` and a short-lived alert if it jumps > X% in 5m. also emit a per-flag sample of requests (1/1000) with header `x-flag-ttl` for debugging.

emily-dx: for console UX, add a per-flag timeline showing TTL changes and correlated latency/cost deltas for last 7 days. helps owners see impact before/after.

sara: thanks. i'll: 1) default UI to "new snapshots only", 2) emit `flag.ttl.updated` event with actor/trace, 3) add sampling header, 4) wire alert rule prototype.

jess-runbooks: add a runbook step: if alert fires, temporarily set TTL back to previous value + notify flag owner + open rollback PR.

miguel: tiny API note — please bump PATCH idempotency header `If-Match` for the TTL change, we had a race where two consoles stomped each other.

sara: noted. i'll add optimistic-locking via etag. snippet i plan to use:
```
PATCH /api/flags/:id
Headers: If-Match: "<etag>"
Body: { "ttl_seconds": 600, "apply_to_active_snapshots": false }
```

miguel: perfect. one more ask — log a diagnostic event that links the change to a recent deploy (if any) so we don't misattribute.

sara: will do. i'll update the sandbox and drop a follow-up when i flip to staging. want to schedule a 15m quick-check after staging deploy tomorrow?

emily-dx: yes please, +1 for a quick check.

jess-runbooks: i'll prep rollback checklist and notification templates.

sara: thanks team — i'll iterate and post the staging link here. :sparkles:
